minecraft:written_book_content.title: WT Workshop Handbook
minecraft:written_book_content.author: WT Network
pages: {"text": "2. Patterns\nPut a blank pattern in the Part Builder and click the part you want to carve. Patterns are reusable."}
{"text": "3. Parts\nPattern + material in the Part Builder. Wood, stone, flint, bone, bamboo, blaze rods, diamonds, string, leather, honeycomb and chain work here."}
{"text": "4. Metal parts\nCopper, iron, gold, rose gold, amethyst bronze and netherite must be cast in a Smeltery."}
{"text": "5. Smeltery\nBricks around a furnace. Add fuel and things to melt. Ores melt into double metal!"}

{"text": "Alloys mix by themselves while lit:
3 copper + 1 gold = rose gold
copper + amethyst = amethyst bronze
4 scrap + 4 gold = netherite"}
{"text": "With a cast in place the selected metal is cast into that part. With no cast, metal is cast into blocks."}
{"text": "7. Tool Station\nStick over a crafting table, planks on the sides and below. Put a head, handle and binding in to build a tool."}

{"text": "Tools
Pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe: head + handle + binding.
Sword: blade + handle + guard.
Hammer, excavator, broad axe: big head + tough handle + tough binding."}
{"text": "Heavy tools\nHammers and excavators dig 3x3. Broad axes fell whole trees. Sneak to mine one block."}
{"text": "8. Refitting\nPut a tool in the Tool slot and ONE of: a new part, its head material (repairs 25% each), a modifier item, or a sponge (removes the last modifier)."}
{"text": "Worn tools\nTools never break. At 1 durability they stop working until repaired."}
{"text": "9. Levels\nMining with the right tool or hitting with a sword earns XP. Each level: +1 upgrade slot and +2% stats. Levels 5 and 10: +1 ability slot."}

{"text": "Upgrades
Haste: 16 redstone
Sharpness: 16 quartz
Reinforced: 2 obsidian
Luck: 32 lapis (max 3)
Fiery: 12 blaze powder
Knockback: 8 slime"}

{"text": "More upgrades
Magnetic: compass
Expanded: 4 pistons (heavy tools)
Diamond: +500 durability
Emerald: +50%
Netherite: needs Diamond

Blocks count 9 (quartz 4)."}

{"text": "Abilities
Silky: golden apple
Autosmelt: 4 blaze rods
Mending: 16 bottles o' enchanting

Silky can't mix with Luck or Autosmelt."}
{"text": "10. Traits\nMaterials add traits. Hold Shift over a part or tool to read them. Gold doubles XP, rose gold adds a slot, iron is magnetic..."}
